abstract: Eighteen patients with pure seminoma in advanced Stages IIC-IV of disease were treated with VIP combination chemotherapy consisting of vinblastine (6 mg/m2, days 1 and 2), ifosfamide (1.5 g/m2, days 1 to 5), and cisplatin (20 mg/m2, days 1 to 5). Eleven patients had Stage IIC, four had Stage III, three had Stage IV, and two had primary extragonadal seminoma. Primary histologic diagnoses were typical seminoma in 15 patients and anaplastic seminoma in three patients. Human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) levels were elevated to 350 U/1 in eight patients; alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) levels were always normal. No primary lymphadenectomy was carried out. Seven of 18 patients had prior radiotherapy and were treated because of relapse or progression. There was one early death and one patient has not yet completed therapy. Of 16 evaluable patients, 14 reached complete remission (CR) (88%), which was documented surgically in six cases, whereas in the non-pretreated group, all nine patients reached CR and in the pretreated group, CR could be induced in five of seven patients (71%). The remission duration ranged from 6+ to 41+ months (median, 29+ months). No relapse has occurred. The bone marrow toxicity of VIP was remarkable. Because of leukopenia below 1000/mm3 and/or thrombopenia below 50,000/mm3, dose reduction and interval prolongation were necessary in 10 of 16 patients, especially in all those who were pretreated. Even though it is not superior to other platin-based regimens, VIP chemotherapy is highly effective in bulky seminoma with and without prior radiotherapy.
abstract_ja: 進行期（病期IIC～IV）の純粋セミノーマ患者18例に、VIP併用化学療法（ビンブラスチン6 mg/m2 第1・2日、イホスファミド1.5 g/m2 第1～5日、シスプラチン20 mg/m2 第1～5日）を施行した。病期IICが11例、病期IIIが4例、病期IVが3例、原発性性腺外セミノーマが2例であった。初回組織診断は典型的セミノーマ15例、異型セミノーマ3例であった。8例ではhCGが350 U/Lまで上昇し、αフェトプロテイン（AFP）は常に正常範囲内であった。原発巣リンパ節郭清は行わなかった。18例中7例は以前に放射線療法を受けており、再発または進行のために治療を行った。早期死亡が1例、治療未完了が1例あった。評価可能な16例中14例（88%）が完全寛解（CR）に達し、6例では外科的に確認された。前治療のなかった群では9例全例がCRに達し、前治療群では7例中5例（71%）でCRが得られた。寛解期間は6+～41+か月（中央値29+か月）であった。再発例はない。VIP療法の骨髄毒性は顕著であった。白血球数1000/mm3未満および/または血小板数50,000/mm3未満のため、16例中10例で減量と投与間隔延長が必要であった。特に前治療例ではすべてで必要であった。白金製剤を含む他のレジメンより優れているわけではないが、VIP療法は放射線療法の前治療の有無にかかわらず、巨大セミノーマに対して非常に有効である。
